notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Scope: the repository has several entry symbols; this package exposes the SR865.labscript_device:SR865 lock-in amplifier only, because G7 requires one native class. The SignalGenerator Models (RS_SMF100A, RS_SMHU), NovaTechDDS and PulseBlaster entry symbols of the same repository are not covered; they are compile-time labscript devices with other workers and command maps. Reads report the instrument indexes OFLT? and SCAL? as tau_index and sens_index because the upstream worker queries and returns indexes; time_constant (seconds) and sensitivity (volts) are written from the upstream sens/tau arrays and translated to the same 0-based indexes numpy.digitize computes. The phase range -180..180 is the range the upstream docstring says the device converts into. The e-stop writes *CLS, the status-clear command the upstream worker also sends at initialization; this driver controls no output, so the measurement settings are left alone. The identity probe is disabled (idn = False) because the upstream worker does not query *IDN?. No hardware backend was run; the wire syntax and the instrument behaviour were not tried on an instrument. Model-authored and unreviewed (reviewed_by null). check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
